top_band: orange-red back rim at row 1 and light tan top surface across rows 2-4, with a dark red front lip at row 5
evidence: Reading down a middle column: row 1 is the orange-red back rim, rows 2-4 are the light tan horizontal top surface (with small objects resting on it), row 5 is the dark red overhanging front edge of the top slab, row 6 is the shadowed upper frame of the cabinet face (inset by 1px on each side beneath the top overhang), and rows 6-31 form the vertical front face with 4x3 recessed drawers and feet.
